# 225 “不是我造的不用”与合法分叉
zg361_mechanism_225_choice_a_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = zg361_mechanism_225_choice } }
		zg361_init_org_ledger_effect = yes
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mechanism_225_choice value = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_org_delivery add = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_org_stability add = 2 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_org_tech_debt add = -2 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_org_admin_load add = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_mechanism_configured_n add = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_mechanism_checksum add = 225 }
		debug_log = "ZG361M: CASE 225 CHOICE A APPLIED"
	}
}

zg361_mechanism_225_ai_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_trait = just
				has_trait = honest
				has_trait = diligent
				has_trait = compassionate
			}
		}
		zg361_mechanism_225_choice_a_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_trait = arbitrary
				has_trait = callous
				has_trait = deceitful
				has_trait = ambitious
			}
		}
		zg361_mechanism_225_choice_b_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_org_budget_pressure
			var:zg361_org_budget_pressure >= 25
		}
		zg361_mechanism_225_choice_c_effect = yes
	}
	else = {
		zg361_mechanism_225_choice_a_effect = yes
	}
}
